title: EnergyBench: a live, gate-aligned benchmark of day-ahead forecasts for European power markets
abstract: arXiv:2611.07784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy forecasting models are usually compared on backtests and fixed public datasets. Backtests can use data that did not yet exist when the forecast would have been made, and a fixed test set, reused across studies and possibly contained in the pretraining data of foundation models, invites overfitting to the benchmark. EnergyBench evaluates every entry live instead. Each day at 11:30 CET/CEST, thirty minutes before the day-ahead (SDAC) gate closes, every model forecasts the next day's price, wind and solar generation and load on the 15-minute grid for six bidding zones (BE, NL, FR, DE-LU, DK1, DK2). Unlike existing live benchmarks, EnergyBench runs the models itself, on one information set that it freezes at the cut-off and publishes, including three numerical weather prediction models, so that foundation models can be compared with and without the same weather covariates under the actual market deadline. Errors are pooled per series

translated_title: EnergyBench：一个面向欧洲电力市场的实时、与交易闸门对齐的日前预测基准
translated_abstract: 能源预测模型通常在回测和固定的公开数据集上进行比较。回测可能使用在预测本应做出的时刻尚不存在的数据，而一个在多项研究间重复使用、且可能已包含在基础模型预训练数据中的固定测试集，容易导致对基准的过拟合。EnergyBench 改为对每个参赛模型进行实时评估。每天中欧时间（CET/CEST）11:30，即日前（SDAC）交易闸门关闭前三十分钟，每个模型在15分钟粒度上对六个竞价区域（比利时、荷兰、法国、德卢、丹麦DK1、丹麦DK2）预测次日的价格、风电与光伏发电量以及负荷。与现有的实时基准不同，EnergyBench 自行运行这些模型，使用一个在截止时刻冻结并公开发布的统一信息集，其中包括三个数值天气预报模型，从而使基础模型能够在真实的市场截止期限下，在相同天气协变量条件下进行对比。
tldr: EnergyBench 是一个对欧洲电力市场日前预测进行实时评估的基准，它在每日交易闸门关闭前自行运行各模型，并使用冻结且公开的统一信息集（含数值天气预报），从而避免了回测数据泄露和固定测试集过拟合的问题。
en_tdlr: EnergyBench is a live benchmark that runs day-ahead forecasting models in real time before the European market gate closes, using a frozen and published information set to eliminate data leakage and benchmark overfitting.
